description: This is a JavaScript source file that implements image rotation functionalities, extending jQuery with methods to rotate elements and handle rotation animations, including support for various browsers and VML fallback for older IE versions.

classes.name: Wilq32.PhotoEffect
classes.description: A class handling the rotation effects for an image or DOM element, including setup parameters, animation, and browser-specific rendering logic.

methods.name: rotate
methods.description: Rotates the selected elements by a specified angle, with optional animation.

methods.name: getRotateAngle
methods.description: Returns the current rotation angles of the selected elements.

methods.name: stopRotate
methods.description: Stops any ongoing rotation animations on the selected elements.
